script: Astronauts grow taller in space. Without gravity pressing down, the discs in their spines spread apart. They can gain up to about 5 centimeters in height. Spacesuits have to allow room for the extra height. Back on Earth, they shrink to their normal height soon after returning. Follow WonderBytes for more facts that sound fake but are true.
